intro.text: A member of the listener Council of Five in Narak, representing workform.

items.text: Davim joined the Council of Five in workform. When Venli proposed that the listeners take on stormform, he was eager to try it, but agreed with Eshonai that she should be the one to test it, as Venli was too important to lose. He was also worried about losing Eshonai, their last remaining Shardbearer.

When Eshonai returned changed by stormform, Davim was at first angry that she hadn't shared her plans with the Five, then wary of her plan to transform all the listeners. Once he asked how the new form felt, he became far more interested, and meant to speak to her further away from the others. Eshonai believed he was already on her side.

appearance.text: Broad-faced, with skin mostly black with some red swirls; wears workform.

personality.text: Impatient and eager for stormform despite its dangers, but reasonable and fairly careful, and sees that the Five must stay united. The power of the new form tempts him.
